```{python}
#| include: false
import json

import _common as c

r = c.restaurants()[[
    "place_id", "name", "website", "cuisine_type", "category", "price", "rating",
    "review_count", "area", "walk_min_to_downtown", "walk_min_to_stadium",
]].fillna({"website": ""})
h = c.hours()[["place_id", "day_of_week", "open_minute", "close_minute"]]
cal = c.calendar()
cal["date"] = cal["date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
cal = cal[["date", "term_phase", "academic_term", "is_home_game", "events",
           "expected_crowd", "crowd_label", "crowd_reason"]].fillna({"events": ""})
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
# The data is embedded in the page as JSON, so the planner needs no server.
payload = {name: json.loads(df.to_json(orient="records")) for name, df in
           [("restaurants", r), ("hours", h), ("calendar", cal)]}
print(c.raw('<script type="application/json" id="planner-data">'
            + json.dumps(payload).replace("</", "<\\/") + "</script>"))
```

::: {.tagline}
Pick a day and a time. The planner checks the Penn State calendar for that date, then lists the restaurants open at that hour.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("planner-data").textContent)
R = DATA.restaurants
H = DATA.hours
C = new Map(DATA.calendar.map(d => [d.date, d]))
DAYS = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]
AREAS = ["Downtown", "Walkable from downtown", "Near the stadium", "Drive or bus"]
CATEGORIES = ["Everything", ...new Set(R.map(d => d.category))].sort((a, b) => a === "Everything" ? -1 : b === "Everything" ? 1 : a.localeCompare(b))

function clock(m) {
  m = m % 1440
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60), mm = String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")
  const suffix = h < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"
  return `${h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12}:${mm} ${suffix}`
}

TIMES = {
  const t = []
  for (let m = 6 * 60; m < 24 * 60; m += 60) t.push([clock(m), m])
  for (const m of [1440, 1500, 1560]) t.push([`${clock(m)} (that night)`, m])
  return new Map(t)
}

START = new Date("2026-08-15T00:00:00Z")
END = new Date("2027-08-14T00:00:00Z")
DEFAULT_DAY = {
  const today = new Date(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + "T00:00:00Z")
  return today >= START && today <= END ? today : new Date("2026-10-10T00:00:00Z")
}
```

::: {.ojs-inputs}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof day = Inputs.date({label: "Date", value: DEFAULT_DAY, min: START, max: END})
viewof time = Inputs.select(TIMES, {label: "Time", value: 18 * 60})
viewof category = Inputs.select(CATEGORIES, {label: "Looking for"})
viewof areas = Inputs.checkbox(AREAS, {label: "Area", value: AREAS})
viewof sortBy = Inputs.radio(["Best rated", "Most reviewed", "Closest to downtown", "Closest to stadium"], {label: "Sort by", value: "Best rated"})
```
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
dateKey = day ? day.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : null
info = dateKey ? C.get(dateKey) : null
weekday = day ? DAYS[day.getUTCDay()] : null
prevDay = day ? DAYS[(day.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7] : null

ADVICE = ({
  1: "Most students are away on break. Getting a table is easy, but check holiday hours before you go.",
  2: "It's summer, and many students are away; some campus-area places keep shorter hours.",
  3: "A normal day in a college town.",
  4: "Book dinner if you can.",
  5: "Expect long waits downtown. Book ahead, eat early, or pick a place outside downtown."
})

html`<div class="crowd-banner">
  <div style="font-size:1.15rem; font-family: var(--bs-headings-font-family, Georgia)">
    ${day ? day.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {weekday: "long", year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC"}) : "Pick a date"}
  </div>
  ${info ? html`
    <div style="margin-top:.3em"><span class="crowd-swatch crowd-${info.expected_crowd}"></span><b>${info.crowd_label}</b> · ${info.crowd_reason}</div>
    ${info.events && info.events !== info.crowd_reason ? html`<div style="margin-top:.2em">Also: ${info.events}</div>` : ""}
    <div style="margin-top:.3em">${ADVICE[info.expected_crowd]}
    ${info.is_home_game ? " Home game today: downtown and the roads around the stadium fill up hours before kickoff." : ""}</div>
  ` : html`<div style="margin-top:.3em">This date is outside the 2026–27 calendar (Aug 15, 2026 – Aug 14, 2027).</div>`}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
openWindows = {
  const out = new Map()
  for (const w of H) {
    const today = w.day_of_week === weekday && w.open_minute <= time && w.close_minute > time
    const lastNight = w.day_of_week === prevDay && w.close_minute > time + 1440
    if (today || lastNight) {
      const closes = today ? w.close_minute : w.close_minute - 1440
      out.set(w.place_id, Math.max(out.get(w.place_id) ?? 0, closes))
    }
  }
  return out
}

matches = {
  const busy = info && info.expected_crowd >= 4
  const rows = R.filter(d => openWindows.has(d.place_id)
    && areas.includes(d.area)
    && (category === "Everything" || d.category === category))
    .map(d => ({...d, closes: openWindows.get(d.place_id),
                likelyBusy: busy && d.area === "Downtown" && d.review_count >= 500}))
  const key = {
    "Best rated": (a, b) => b.rating - a.rating || b.review_count - a.review_count,
    "Most reviewed": (a, b) => b.review_count - a.review_count,
    "Closest to downtown": (a, b) => a.walk_min_to_downtown - b.walk_min_to_downtown,
    "Closest to stadium": (a, b) => a.walk_min_to_stadium - b.walk_min_to_stadium
  }[sortBy]
  return rows.sort(key)
}

html`<h2 style="margin-top:.6em">${matches.length} ${matches.length === 1 ? "place" : "places"} open ${weekday ? `on ${weekday} at ${clock(time)}` : ""}</h2>
<ul class="listing">
${matches.map(d => html`<li>
  ${d.website ? html`<a href=${d.website} target="_blank" rel="noopener">${d.name}</a>` : d.name}
  ${d.likelyBusy ? html`<b style="font-size:.8rem"> · likely busy</b>` : ""}
  <span class="meta"> · ${d.cuisine_type}${d.price ? ` · ${d.price}` : ""} · ${d.rating ? `★ ${d.rating.toFixed(1)} (${d.review_count.toLocaleString()} reviews)` : "no rating yet"} ·
  ${d.walk_min_to_downtown} min walk to downtown, ${d.walk_min_to_stadium} to the stadium · open until ${d.closes >= 1440 ? clock(d.closes) + " (late)" : clock(d.closes)}</span>
</li>`)}
</ul>`
```

## How this works

- **Crowd level** comes from the [calendar](calendar.qmd): a rule-based estimate from 1 (very quiet) to 5 (packed), built from the official Penn State academic calendar, the 2026 football schedule, THON and Arts Fest.
- **Open now** uses each restaurant's regular weekly hours from Google (March 2026). Late-night times such as "1:00 AM (that night)" check places that stay open past midnight. Holiday and break hours are not included, so check ahead during breaks.
- **Likely busy** marks downtown places with 500+ reviews on busy or packed days. It's a heuristic, not live data.
- **Walking times** are estimates: straight-line distance × 1.3 at 5 km/h.

All of this runs in your browser. There's no server, account or tracking.
